items.question: How must the practitioner perform mantra recitation in secrecy?
premises: The recitation must remain secret
The goddess is addressed directly

items.question: Which goddesses are invoked to protect the ears and speech?
premises: Toḍalā is associated with the pair of ears
Tripurā is associated with speech

items.inference: Toḍalā protects the ears and Tripurā protects the speech of the practitioner.
items.plain_english: May Toḍalā protect my pair of ears, and may Tripurā protect my speech.

The heart is qualified as with visarga

items.question: What supreme attainment is assured by this armor without doubt?
